video_title: Is a deal coming soon for Karl-Anthony Towns? 🤔 + Latest on Jalen Duren & the Pistons | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns and the Knicks are far apart on contract extension
quotes.excerpt: the two sides are tens of millions of dollars apart on where they want to be

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: What is the most important thing to know about where these talks stand between Karl-Anthony Towns and the Knicks?

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: My arms can't go wide enough to say how far these two sides are right now. Karl-Anthony Towns is not looking for a $276 million extension. He wants to be rewarded for the sacrifices that he's made, but the two sides are tens of millions of dollars apart on where they want to be right now. And it doesn't seem to be much wiggle room. Don't forget, Josh Hart is eligible for an extension. Duane Washington Jr. wants a contract extension. When you're a champion, this is the last thing that you want coming into the season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks core five are back but salary cap constraints loom
quotes.excerpt: unless these guys are willing to take pay cuts, the five of them are not staying together

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I'm going to say two things Knicks fans need to know that are simple but important. Number one, all five Knicks top five players are back to play this season. They lost Mitchell Robinson, but their core five are back. That's great. They got the whole team back, they can compete again. The second thing is, unless these guys are willing to take pay cuts, Josh Hart, Karl-Anthony Towns, the five of them are not staying together. That's just the reality.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Karl-Anthony Towns from what I have been told is willing, similarly to what Jalen Brunson did, to take a pay cut. But the pay cut that the Knicks are asking him to take, he views as unreasonable.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren and Pistons remain at a contract stalemate
quotes.excerpt: there is clearly a disconnect in the relationship business here

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: That ain't the greatest sign when your President of Basketball Operations is offering you $200 million and he can't get you on the phone or he doesn't want to get you on the phone. There is clearly a disconnect in the relationship business here. And that Bobby Marks note, pay close attention to that. If it's extended beyond October 1st, that means both sides will continue negotiating. That means at least there's a signal that this could not be operating in good faith.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Does it make sense financially to do the qualifying offer ahead of becoming a restricted free agent?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Maybe, because if he knows 100% he's getting a max contract next year, he can make up the money he'd leave on the table.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis will decide on contract extension after the season
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go through the season and try to do what I do at a high level

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Davis
text_blocks.text: I'm going to go through the season and try to do what I do at a high level. And then, you know, when it's over, sit down and have those conversations again with front office.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Remember, Shams reported over the summer that there was going to be 20 or 30 games and then they were going to reevaluate. Now he says he's going to wait the whole season. I think this is a good development. Let's not have mid-season pressure on this.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper rejects the idea of coming off the bench
quotes.excerpt: That's crazy. F*** no. I ain't coming off no bench.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: He gets asked about coming off the bench. He says, 'What's the political answer here?' And then he looks down at his recorder being recorded. He calibrates his voice. I'm going to do whatever the team needs me to do, man. If that's come off the bench. He stops. That's crazy. F*** no. I ain't coming off no bench.

text_blocks.speaker: Dylan Harper
text_blocks.text: I'm going to do whatever the team needs me to do, man. If that's come off the bench. That's crazy. F*** no. I ain't coming off no bench.

quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards is happy with Timberwolves offseason moves
quotes.quote: I didn't know none about that, but yeah, I'm happy.
